decision.exact_command_or_message: Do not spawn imm26-nativecomp2 now: the coordinator is in its context-limit handoff (meter says start NOTHING new) and has already told all agents to stop. imm26-nativecomp STOPPED-CONTEXT 14:44 is the expected result of that stop order and is already listed in HANDOFF 'Stopped at the limit' (respawn fresh from agents\imm26-nativecomp.handoff.md as imm26-nativecomp2). Keep waiting for the remaining RUNNING agents (claude-md-reviewer, imm26-4080-op2, imm26-wpA3, imm26-wpB3, program-ledger) to report STOPPED-CONTEXT, up to the ~10 min window, then stop stragglers, run handoff-ready.ps1 and open the next coordinator, which spawns the successors.
decision.why: The nativecomp stop is the ordered handoff stop; successors are spawned by the new coordinator, and the successor's own agent-status call (not the coordinator) marks it RUNNING.
